record.one_liner: Plaid is an API platform that enables applications to securely connect users' financial accounts for data access, payments, and identity verification.

auth_methods.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret . These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET .

access_test.quote: You'll need API keys, which you can receive by signing up in the Dashboard . You'll have two different API keys, and there are two different Plaid environments. Today we'll start in the Sandbox environment.

access_ship.quote: Production Test or launch your app with unlimited live credentials

api_type.quote: The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP. Requests are POST requests, and responses are JSON

api_breadth.quote: Here you'll find guides, resources, and references to build with Plaid.
